```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests on Windows

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go mod download
        go get github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser@latest
        go install github.com/mise-tool/mise@latest

    - name: Format and lint code
      run: mise run fmt && mise run lint

    - name: Run unit and integration tests
      run: mise run test:ci

    - name: Skip interactive E2E tests
      run: echo "Skipping interactive E2E tests on Windows"

    - name: Notify on failure
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "::error::Windows E2E tests failed"
        # Add Slack notification logic here if needed

  e2e-main:
    needs: e2e-windows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go mod download
        go get github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser@latest

    - name: Format and lint code

    - name: Run unit and integration tests
      run: mise run test:ci

    - name: Run Windows E2E tests

        # Add Windows E2E test command here
        echo "Running Windows E2E tests"

    - name: Notify on failure
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "::error::Main E2E tests failed"
        # Add Slack notification logic here if needed
```
